ZMB.note: The document concerns skills for young people and women; nothing on civil servants.

facts.fact: SMART Zambia Institute, with the ITU and the Ministry of Youth, Sport and Arts, runs the Digital Transformation Centres Initiative to equip young people and women with digital skills, and has handed ICT equipment to the Mpika Youth Resource Centre with more handovers planned.
